profile.description: 2026 review completed. Gate City Oktoberfest is Sept. 26, 2026 at Lookout Point in Historic Downtown Pocatello. The current official listing centers on German/craft beer tasting, food and live music, requires valid government-issued photo ID, and states attendees must be 21+ to purchase tickets. This is not an appropriate routine Adventure Zone inflatable-carnival prospect.

notes.body: Current official 2026 information confirms Gate City Oktoberfest is Sept. 26, 2026, 4-8 PM at Lookout Point and is built around beer/cider tasting, food and live music. The event requires ID and is effectively an adult beer-tasting event, so do not create routine Adventure Zone inflatable-carnival outreach or follow-up.
